description: This file provides various functions related to network interface configuration in OpenWrt, including finding configurations, calling ubus commands, fixing interface settings, scanning interfaces, and setting sysctl parameters.

methods.name: find_config
methods.description: Finds network configuration matching the specified device name by iterating over network interfaces.

methods.name: ubus_call
methods.description: Performs a ubus call and loads the JSON response.

methods.name: fixup_interface
methods.description: Adjusts interface configuration, especially for bridged interfaces.

methods.name: scan_interfaces
methods.description: Loads network configuration and applies fixup to each interface.

methods.name: prepare_interface_bridge
methods.description: Prepares a network interface bridge via ubus.

methods.name: setup_interface
methods.description: Adds a device to a network interface via ubus.
